summary: Validate and publish the first functional CallerSignal release
description: Ship the proven caller-campaign intelligence product only after cross-surface parity, privacy, safety, and country-adapter gates pass.
acceptance: R-1: NL, GB, and US lookups, campaign intelligence, private watch, verified organisation context, transparency, and hosted MCP pass contract, integration, privacy, and cross-surface parity tests.
